title: Interlock Logic & Cause Effect Matrix - KC-4501 (SEQ-4501)
content:
INTERLOCK LOGIC & CAUSE EFFECT MATRIX: SEQ-4501 (RECYCLE GAS COMPRESSOR (KC-4501) SHUTDOWN LOGIC).
Document No: TJC-LLD-IL-KC-4501, Revision: Rev.03, Status: Issued for Operation, SIL Level: SIL 2.
Equipment: KC-4501, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-4500-01.
CAUSE & EFFECT MATRIX (TRIPS):
- T1: Lube oil pressure LOW-LOW (PSLL-4504 < 1.5 barg, 2oo3) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Open Min-Flow (EFF-2), Close Discharge (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
- T2: Discharge temperature HIGH-HIGH (TSHH-4503 > 140 degC, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Open Min-Flow (EFF-2), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
- T3: Discharge pressure HIGH-HIGH (PSHH-4502 > 14 barg, 1oo2) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Open Min-Flow (EFF-2), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
- T4: Crosshead vibration HIGH-HIGH (VSHH-4505 > 11 mm/s, 1oo2) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Open Min-Flow (EFF-2), Close Discharge (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
- T5: Suction KO drum level HIGH-HIGH (LSHH-4510 > 80 %, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Close Discharge (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
- T6: Suction pressure LOW-LOW (PSLL-4501 < 0.3 barg, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Open Min-Flow (EFF-2), DCS Alarm (EFF-5)
START PERMISSIVES (AND-gate conditions to start):
- P1: Lube oil pressure OK (> 2 barg) (PSLL-4504, Gate: AND)
- P2: Seal gas established (FT-4506, Gate: AND)
- P3: KO drum level normal (< 50%) (LT-4510, Gate: AND)
- P4: Jacket water flow OK (FSL-4508, Gate: AND)
- P5: No active trip / reset done (DCS reset, Gate: AND)
- —: ALL permissives TRUE → START KC-4501 ENABLED (—, Gate: AND)
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-4501, Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-KC-4501.

title: One Point Lesson - Lube Oil System Pre-Start & Priming (OPL-KC-4501-01)
content:
ONE POINT LESSON (OPL): OPL-KC-4501-01 - Lube Oil System Pre-Start & Priming.

Equipment: KC-4501, Discipline: Mechanical, Area: 4500 - RECYCLE GAS SYSTEM.

References: Interlock: SEQ-4501 (SIL 2), P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-4501.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
This One Point Lesson explains lube oil system pre-start & priming for KC-4501 in the RECYCLE GAS SYSTEM. With no lube oil pressure the crankshaft bearings fail in seconds; the pre-lube pump must build pressure before the machine is cranked.

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS:
- Precaution 1: Apply LOTO (Lock-Out Tag-Out) and prove zero energy before starting work.
- Precaution 2: Isolate, depressurise, drain and purge the equipment; obtain a valid work permit.
- Precaution 3: Wear the correct PPE: coverall, safety shoes, gloves, goggles and hearing protection.
- Precaution 4: Beware of stored mechanical energy (springs, rotating inertia) and pinch points.
- Precaution 5: Use certified lifting gear and correct manual-handling technique for heavy parts.

TOOLS & MATERIALS:
- Tool 1: Standard mechanical hand tools & calibrated torque wrench
- Tool 2: LOTO padlocks and permit
- Tool 3: Laser/dial alignment kit (as applicable)
- Tool 4: Feeler gauges, dial indicator, seal/bearing pullers
- Tool 5: Correct spare parts and gaskets per the BOM
- Tool 6: Lifting gear and slings (certified)

STEP-BY-STEP PROCEDURE:
- Step 1 - Action: Run the auxiliary lube oil pump and build pressure above 2 barg
- Step 1 - Check: Isolation & LOTO verified
- Step 2 - Action: Confirm PSLL-4504 shows healthy oil pressure
- Step 2 - Check: Parts match BOM / spec
- Step 3 - Action: Check the frame oil level and the filter differential pressure
- Step 3 - Check: Torque / clearance to spec
- Step 4 - Action: Verify no oil leaks and correct oil grade in the frame
- Step 4 - Check: No leak / smooth operation
- Step 5 - Action: Only then give the start command to the main motor
- Step 5 - Check: Record in equipment history

COMMON PROBLEMS & TROUBLESHOOTING:
- Symptom: High discharge temperature trip TSHH-4503, capacity drop | Cause: 1st stage suction plate valve fractured | Action: Replaced complete suction valve set, checked seat, leak tested
- Symptom: KC-4501 tripped on PSLL-4504 low lube oil pressure | Cause: Lube oil pump gears worn, relief valve set low | Action: Overhauled lube oil pump, reset relief valve, verified 2.5 barg
- Symptom: High blow-by, low 2nd stage efficiency | Cause: PTFE piston rings worn beyond limit | Action: Renewed 2nd stage PTFE piston and rider rings, honed cylinder

KEY LEARNING POINTS:
- Point 1: With no lube oil pressure the crankshaft bearings fail in seconds; the pre-lube pump must build pressure before the machine is cranked.
- Point 2: Respect the interlock SEQ-4501: e.g. PSLL-4504 trips at < 1.5 barg - never defeat it without a permit.
- Point 3: Always cross-check the Datasheet limits and the P&ID TJC-LLD-PID-4501 before working on KC-4501.
- Point 4: Record the work in the equipment history so the Knowledge Hub stays the single source of truth.

title: One Point Lesson - Crosshead Vibration Monitoring (VSHH-4505) (OPL-KC-4501-05)
content:

Equipment: KC-4501, Discipline: Instrument, Area: 4500 - RECYCLE GAS SYSTEM.

References: Interlock: SEQ-4501 (SIL 2), P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-4501.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
This One Point Lesson explains crosshead vibration monitoring (vshh-4505) for KC-4501 (RECYCLE GAS COMPRESSOR) in the RECYCLE GAS SYSTEM. A rising crosshead vibration trend warns of loose running gear before it trips or fails. The lesson gives operators and technicians the key knowledge and the correct step-by-step method so the task is done safely, correctly and consistently every time.

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS:
- Precaution 1: De-energise and isolate the loop; place the function to bypass/inhibit under permit.
- Precaution 2: Inform the panel operator before working on any trip, valve or transmitter.
- Precaution 3: Take care with instrument air / hydraulic pressure when disconnecting tubing.
- Precaution 4: Verify intrinsic-safety / Ex integrity is restored before returning to service.
- Precaution 5: Wear correct PPE and follow ESD/override control procedures.

TOOLS & MATERIALS:
- Tool 1: HART communicator / positioner software (e.g. ValveLink)
- Tool 2: Loop calibrator & decade box / pressure source
- Tool 3: Digital multimeter and clamp meter
- Tool 4: Span/zero test gas or reference standards
- Tool 5: Torque screwdriver and small hand tools
- Tool 6: Certified test/inhibit permit

STEP-BY-STEP PROCEDURE:
- Step 1 - Action: Trend VT-4501 crosshead vibration on the daily route
- Step 1 - Check: Loop isolated / under permit
- Step 2 - Action: Alarm at 8 mm/s and trip at 11 mm/s (VSHH-4505)
- Step 2 - Check: Reference standard traceable
- Step 3 - Action: Correlate any rise with TE-4507 main bearing temperature
- Step 3 - Check: As-found & as-left recorded
- Step 4 - Action: Investigate rod-load reversals and crosshead pin clearance
- Step 4 - Check: Trip / control action verified
- Step 5 - Action: Escalate a sudden step-change to reliability immediately
- Step 5 - Check: Return to service confirmed

- Symptom: Proof test of lube oil low-low trip | Cause: Set-point within tolerance | Action: Recalibrated PSLL-4504 to 1.5 barg, function tested
- Symptom: Seal gas flow FT-4506 low, buffer pressure unstable | Cause: N2 buffer regulator diaphragm failed | Action: Replaced seal gas regulator, re-established buffer dP
- Symptom: Proof test of KO drum high-high level trip | Cause: Float healthy, minor set-point trim | Action: Verified LSHH-4510 float and trip action

KEY LEARNING POINTS:
- Point 1: A rising crosshead vibration trend warns of loose running gear before it trips or fails.
